9	/-!
10	# Base change of the two-term complex and of `H¹` on the relative curve
11	
12	CBC-1/2 for the structure sheaf, bundled: for the curve bundle `C` over a field `k`, a
13	tower of test rings `R → R'` (commutative `k`-algebras) and the base-changed affine
14	two-cover `relCover C R D` of the relative curve `C_R`, this file base-changes the
15	two-term Čech complex `Γ(V₀ᴿ) × Γ(V₁ᴿ) → Γ(V₀ᴿ ⊓ V₁ᴿ)` along `R → R'` and deduces the
16	degree-one comparison isomorphism — Kleiman's "cohomology commutes with base change" in
17	the curve-lite two-cover form.
18	
19	* `LinearMap.quotRangeBaseChangeEquiv` — the general right-exactness input: base change
20	  commutes with cokernels, `A ⊗[R] (N ⧸ range f) ≃ₗ[A] (A ⊗[R] N) ⧸ range (f.baseChange A)`.
21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relTermBaseChange` — **CBC-1, termwise**: for a qcqs open
22	  `V ⊆ C.left`, the `R'`-linear equivalence
23	  `R' ⊗[R] Γ(C_R, V_R) ≃ₗ[R'] Γ(C_{R'}, V_{R'})`, with the computation rule
24	  `relTermBaseChange_tmul` (`r' ⊗ y ↦ r' • relSectionsMap y`).
25	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relDiffBaseChange` — **CBC-1, the complex**: the base change of the
26	  two-cover restriction-difference map `TwoCover.diff` over `R` is carried to the
27	  difference map over `R'` under the term equivalences (the commuting square).
28	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relH1CokBaseChange` — **CBC-2 (`i = 1`), cokernel form**:
29	  `R' ⊗[R] H1Cok R (C_R) ≃ₗ[R'] H1Cok R' (C_{R'})`, unconditionally in `R → R'` (the
30	  cokernel of a base-changed complex is the base change of the cokernel; no flatness).
31	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relH1BaseChange` — **CBC-2 (`i = 1`)**: the same statement on the
32	  cohomology carriers, `R' ⊗[R] H¹(C_R, 𝒪) ≃ₗ[R'] H¹(C_{R'}, 𝒪)`, through the landed
33	  relative two-cover identification `relTwoCoverH1`.
34	
35	Degree zero for the structure sheaf needs no separate statement: `H⁰(C_R, 𝒪) ≃+* R`
36	on the nose (`AlgebraicGeometry.relStructureSectionsTop`), so its base change is
37	`R ⊗_R R' ≃ R'`.
38	
39	## Implementation notes
40	
41	The overlap opens `V₀ᴿ ⊓ V₁ᴿ` (the `TwoCover.H1Cok` spelling) and
42	`fst ⁻¹ᵁ (D.V₀ ⊓ D.V₁)` (the base-change spelling) are definitionally equal; statements
43	are given in the `H1Cok` spelling, and spelling adapters are introduced as local `have`s
44	justified by `exact` where the two must meet. See
45	`AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.RelativeSectionsLinear` for the transparency option.
46	-/

58	/-! ## Base change commutes with cokernels -/
59	
60	namespace LinearMap
61	
62	variable {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra R A]
63	variable {M N : Type u} [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
64	variable (f : M →ₗ[R] N)
65	
66	private lemma ker_mkQ_baseChange :
67	    LinearMap.ker ((LinearMap.range f).mkQ.baseChange A) =
68	      LinearMap.range (f.baseChange A) := by
69	  apply LinearMap.exact_iff.mp
70	  rw [LinearMap.baseChange_eq_ltensor, LinearMap.baseChange_eq_ltensor]
71	  exact lTensor_exact A (LinearMap.exact_map_mkQ_range f) (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _)
72	
73	private lemma surjective_mkQ_baseChange :
74	    Function.Surjective ((LinearMap.range f).mkQ.baseChange A) := by
75	  rw [LinearMap.baseChange_eq_ltensor]
76	  exact LinearMap.lTensor_surjective A (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _)
77	
78	/-- **Base change commutes with cokernels**: for a linear map `f : M →ₗ[R] N` and an
79	`R`-algebra `A`, the base change of the cokernel of `f` is the cokernel of the base
80	change of `f`, `A`-linearly. Right-exactness of `A ⊗[R] -` in the two-term form consumed
81	by the Čech-complex base change. -/
82	noncomputable def quotRangeBaseChangeEquiv :
83	    A ⊗[R] (N ⧸ LinearMap.range f) ≃ₗ[A]
84	      (A ⊗[R] N) ⧸ LinearMap.range (f.baseChange A) :=
85	  ((Submodule.quotEquivOfEq _ _ (ker_mkQ_baseChange A f).symm).trans
86	    (((LinearMap.range f).mkQ.baseChange A).quotKerEquivOfSurjective
87	      (surjective_mkQ_baseChange A f))).symm
88	
89	@[simp]
90	lemma quotRangeBaseChangeEquiv_tmul_mk (a : A) (n : N) :
91	    quotRangeBaseChangeEquiv A f (a ⊗ₜ Submodule.Quotient.mk n) =
92	      Submodule.Quotient.mk (a ⊗ₜ n) := by
93	  rw [quotRangeBaseChangeEquiv, ← LinearEquiv.eq_symm_apply, LinearEquiv.symm_symm,
94	    LinearEquiv.trans_apply, Submodule.quotEquivOfEq_mk]
95	  calc ((LinearMap.range f).mkQ.baseChange A).quotKerEquivOfSurjective
96	        (surjective_mkQ_baseChange A f) (Submodule.Quotient.mk (a ⊗ₜ n))
97	      = ((LinearMap.range f).mkQ.baseChange A) (a ⊗ₜ n) := rfl
98	    _ = a ⊗ₜ Submodule.Quotient.mk n := by
99	        rw [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, Submodule.mkQ_apply]
100	
101	end LinearMap

109	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
110	variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
111	variable (R' : Type u) [CommRing R'] [Algebra k R'] [Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R']

113	/-- **CBC-1, termwise**: base change of relative sections along the test-ring change
114	`R → R'`, as an `R'`-linear equivalence
115	`R' ⊗[R] Γ(C_R, V_R) ≃ₗ[R'] Γ(C_{R'}, V_{R'})` for a qcqs open `V ⊆ C.left`. Composite
116	of the two free base-change identifications `relSectionsBaseChange` with the tensor
117	cancellation `(R' ⊗[R] (R ⊗[k] -)) ≃ (R' ⊗[k] -)`. -/
118	noncomputable def relTermBaseChange (V : C.left.Opens)
119	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set C.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set C.left)) :
120	    R' ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) ≃ₗ[R']
121	      Γ(relCurve C R', (fst C (overSpec k R')).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
122	  (LinearEquiv.baseChange R R' _ _ (relSectionsBaseChange C R hV hV').symm).trans
123	    ((AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange k R R' R' Γ(C.left, V)).trans
124	      (relSectionsBaseChange C R' hV hV'))

133	lemma relTermBaseChange_tmul {V : C.left.Opens}
134	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set C.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set C.left))
135	    (r' : R') (y : Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)) :
136	    relTermBaseChange C R R' V hV hV' (r' ⊗ₜ y) =
137	      r' • relSectionsMap C R R' V y := by
138	  obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := (relSectionsBaseChange C R hV hV').surjective y
139	  rw [relTermBaseChange, LinearEquiv.trans_apply, LinearEquiv.baseChange_tmul,
140	    LinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply, LinearEquiv.trans_apply]
141	  induction x with
142	  | zero =>
143	    simp only [map_zero, TensorProduct.tmul_zero, smul_zero]
144	  | add x y hx hy =>
145	    rw [TensorProduct.tmul_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, map_add, hx, hy, smul_add]
146	  | tmul a s =>
147	    rw [AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange_tmul, relSectionsBaseChange_tmul,
148	      relSectionsBaseChange_tmul, map_mul, relSectionsMap_overAlgebraMap,
149	      relSectionsMap_pullback, Scheme.overModule_smul_def, Algebra.smul_def, map_mul,
150	      mul_assoc]
151	    exact mul_left_comm _ _ _

159	noncomputable def relDiffDomBaseChange :
160	    R' ⊗[R] (Γ(relCurve C R, (relCover C R D).V₀) ×

8	/-!
9	# `R`-linear base change of sections on the relative curve
10	
11	For the curve bundle `C` over a field `k` and a commutative `k`-algebra `R` (the affine
12	test ring), the landed `Over.sectionsBaseChange` identifies `Γ(C.left, V) ⊗[k] R` with
13	the sections of the relative curve `C_R := relCurve C R` over the preimage `V_R` — but
14	only as a *ring* equivalence. This file threads the `R`-module structures through it,
15	once, and builds the comparison morphism between relative curves over a change of test
16	ring `R → R'`:
17	
18	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.sectionsBaseChange_one_tmul_overAlgebraMap` — **the
19	  `R`-linear threading lemma**: the base-change equivalence carries `1 ⊗ r` to the
20	  structure pullback `overAlgebraMap R _ r` of `r` along `C_R ⟶ Spec R`. Definitional
21	  once both sides are put in `appLE` normal form.
22	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relSectionsBaseChange` — **sections of the relative curve are the
23	  free base change**: `R ⊗[k] Γ(C.left, V) ≃ₗ[R] Γ(C_R, V_R)` as an `R`-linear
24	  equivalence (`R` acting on the left tensor factor and through `Scheme.overModule` on
25	  the right), with the computation rule `relSectionsBaseChange_tmul`.
26	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relCurveMap` — the comparison morphism `C_{R'} ⟶ C_R` over a
27	  `k`-algebra map `R → R'` (the whiskering of `Spec` of the algebra map), with its
28	  projection identities `relCurveMap_fst`, `relCurveMap_snd` and the preimage identity
29	  `relCurveMap_preimage`.
30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.relSectionsMap` — the induced ring homomorphism
31	  `Γ(C_R, V_R) →+* Γ(C_{R'}, V_{R'})`, with its three governing identities: it commutes
32	  with the curve pullbacks (`relSectionsMap_pullback`), it intertwines the structure
33	  actions along `algebraMap R R'` (`relSectionsMap_overAlgebraMap`, whence the
34	  semilinearity `relSectionsMap_smul`), and it commutes with restriction
35	  (`relSectionsMap_resHom`).
36	
37	These are the CBC-1 ingredients; the two-term complex and `H¹` are base-changed in
38	`AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.RelativeH1BaseChange`.
39	
40	## Implementation notes
41	
42	The module structures are the canonical ones of the landed convention (`Scheme.overModule`
43	and `Over.sectionsAlgebra` as local instances); the threading lemma is what makes the
44	`R`-action on `Γ(C_R, V_R)` (restriction along the *second* projection) match the
45	`R`-action on the tensor factor. The proof of `map_smul'` for `relSectionsBaseChange`
46	deliberately avoids the ring structure on `R ⊗[k] Γ(C.left, V)` (which is not available
47	with the `overModule` instances): it computes on pure tensors through
48	`Over.sectionsBaseChange_tmul`.
49	-/

71	/-! ## The `R`-linear threading of the sections base change -/
72	
73	/-- **Pullback of a curve section to the relative curve** along the first projection,
74	as a section over the base-changed open (typed at `relCurve C R`). -/
75	noncomputable def relPullbackSection (V : C.left.Opens) (s : Γ(C.left, V)) :
76	    Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
77	  (fst C (overSpec k R)).left.appLE V ((fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl s

79	section Threading
80	
81	variable {V : C.left.Opens}
82	
83	/-- **The `R`-linear threading lemma**: the sections base-change equivalence carries
84	`1 ⊗ r` to the pullback of `r` along the structure morphism `relCurve C R ⟶ Spec R`
85	(the `Scheme.overAlgebraMap` of the relative curve). This is the one point where the
86	`R`-action on the tensor factor is matched with the `R`-action on relative sections. -/
87	theorem Over.sectionsBaseChange_one_tmul_overAlgebraMap
88	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set C.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set C.left)) (r : R) :
89	    Over.sectionsBaseChange C R hV hV' (1 ⊗ₜ r) =
90	      (relCurve C R).overAlgebraMap R ((fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) r := by
91	  rw [Over.sectionsBaseChange_one_tmul]
92	  rfl
93	
94	/-- **Sections of the relative curve are the free base change of the curve's sections**:
95	the `R`-linear equivalence `R ⊗[k] Γ(C.left, V) ≃ₗ[R] Γ(relCurve C R, V_R)`, for a qcqs
96	open `V ⊆ C.left`. The underlying map is the landed ring equivalence
97	`Over.sectionsBaseChange` (composed with the flip of the tensor factors); the `R`-module
98	structure on the right is `Scheme.overModule` for the structure morphism to `Spec R`. -/
99	noncomputable def relSectionsBaseChange
100	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set C.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set C.left)) :
101	    R ⊗[k] Γ(C.left, V) ≃ₗ[R]
102	      Γ(relCurve C R, (fst C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) where
103	  toFun x := Over.sectionsBaseChange C R hV hV' (TensorProduct.comm k R Γ(C.left, V) x)
104	  invFun y := (TensorProduct.comm k R Γ(C.left, V)).symm
105	    ((Over.sectionsBaseChange C R hV hV').symm y)
106	  left_inv x := by

111	  map_smul' r x := by

113	    induction x with
114	    | zero => simp only [smul_zero, map_zero]

9	/-!
10	# The widened cover datum: arbitrary affine opens (R2, human decision I-0492)
11	
12	`FinCoverData` (`Picard/DivisorFamily.lean`) types its pieces INTO a fixed pair of pinned
13	`P¹` charts — `h₀ : Fin m₀ → Γ(V₀)`, `h₁ : Fin m₁ → Γ(V₁)`, `pieces = Sum.elim (basicOpen ∘
14	h₀) (basicOpen ∘ h₁)` — with a partition of unity on EACH chart.  Per-piece swallow-or-miss
15	needs only openness (`DivSchemeCertZarConn.lean`), and it is the chart-wise partitions that
16	upgrade "inside one piece" to "inside one chart"; that upgrade is the obstruction, and no
17	repair keeping the pieces inside the preimages of a fixed pair of points of `P¹` can work
18	(`informal/spec-dd-r.md` ADDENDUM 3 §2, ADDENDUM 4 §4.4).
19	
20	This file carries the widened datum.  A piece is an **arbitrary affine open** of the
21	relative curve, the index is a bare `Fin m`, and the covering condition is **joint**
22	(`⨆ j, pieces j = ⊤`) rather than chart-wise.  Nothing types a piece into a chart.
23	
24	Justification for the shape, used and not re-derived (I-0492 clause 2): `supp D` is finite
25	over `R`, hence lies in a single affine open of `C ×_k Spec R` (Stacks `0B8B`), so a cover
26	with one straddling piece always exists.
27	
28	## What the widening RELOCATES rather than removes (I-0492 clause 4(ii))
29	
30	The old typing was silently supplying two things that now have to be earned:
31	
32	* **every point lies in a piece** — was `relCover_sup` plus the two partitions; now it is
33	  exactly the joint covering field (`AffCoverData.exists_mem_pieces`);
34	* **`Γ(pieces j)` is `R`-flat** — was `flat_sections_basicOpen` over
35	  `flat_sections_relPinnedChart`, i.e. it rested on `Γ(V_bᴿ) ≅ R ⊗[k] Γ(C, V_b)` being FREE.
36	  For an arbitrary affine open that route is gone.  Replacement, and it is the one genuinely
37	  new commutative-algebra input the widening costs: `relCurve C R ↘ Spec R` is flat (it is
38	  the base change of `C.hom` along `overSpec k R`, and a morphism to a field spectrum is
39	  flat), and a flat morphism has `R`-flat sections on every affine open
40	  (`flat_sections_of_flat_hom`).  Unconditional in `R` — no Noetherian, no finiteness.
41	
42	Fibrewise-finite support (I-0492 clause 4(i)) is deliberately NOT here: it is not a property
43	of a cover, it must come from the seed's own degree data, and it may not hide inside a
44	`LocalEquations` or an adaptation field.
45	
46	## Main declarations
47	
48	* `AlgebraicGeometry.flat_sections_of_flat_hom` — sections of an arbitrary affine open of a
49	  scheme flat over the base ring are flat.
50	* `AlgebraicGeometry.instFlatRelCurveHom` — the relative curve is flat over its test base.
51	* `AlgebraicGeometry.AffCoverData` — the widened cover datum.
52	* `AffCoverData.exists_mem_pieces`, `isAffineOpen_pieces`, `flat_sections_pieces`,
53	  `flat_sections_pieces_inf` — the derived replacements for what the chart typing supplied.
54	* `AlgebraicGeometry.FinCoverData.toAffCoverData` — the migration: old data instantiates the
55	  widened datum, so nothing landed becomes unreachable.
56	-/

71	
72	The engine that replaces the pinned-chart freeness argument. -/
73	
74	section FlatSections
75	
76	variable (K : Type u) [CommRing K] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of K))]
77	
78	/-- **Sections of an arbitrary affine open are flat, for a scheme flat over the base ring.**
79	`Scheme.overAlgebraMap` factors as `ΓSpecIso.inv` followed by the structure morphism's
80	`appLE ⊤ V`; the second is `RingHom.Flat` because `AlgebraicGeometry.Flat` is a
81	`HasRingHomProperty` for `RingHom.Flat` and `V` is affine, the first is flat because it is a
82	ring isomorphism, and `RingHom.Flat` composes.
83	
84	This is the widened replacement for `flat_sections_basicOpen ∘ flat_sections_relPinnedChart`:
85	that pair needed the open to be a basic open of a chart whose sections are a FREE base
86	change, which is exactly what an arbitrary affine open does not give. -/
87	theorem flat_sections_of_flat_hom [AlgebraicGeometry.Flat (X ↘ Spec (.of K))]
88	    {V : X.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
89	    Module.Flat K Γ(X, V) := by
90	  have happ : RingHom.Flat ((X ↘ Spec (.of K)).appLE ⊤ V (by simp)).hom :=
91	    HasRingHomProperty.appLE (P := @AlgebraicGeometry.Flat)
92	      (f := X ↘ Spec (.of K)) inferInstance ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top _⟩ ⟨V, hV⟩ (by simp)
93	  have hiso : RingHom.Flat ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv).hom :=
94	    RingHom.Flat.of_bijective
95	      (ConcreteCategory.bijective_of_isIso (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv)
96	  have hcomp : RingHom.Flat (X.overAlgebraMap K V) := by
97	    have hfac : X.overAlgebraMap K V
98	        = ((X ↘ Spec (.of K)).appLE ⊤ V (by simp)).hom.comp
99	            ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv).hom := by
100	      rw [Scheme.overAlgebraMap, Scheme.Hom.appLE]
101	      rfl
102	    rw [hfac]
103	    exact RingHom.Flat.comp hiso happ
104	  exact (RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff (R := K) (S := Γ(X, V))).mp hcomp
105	
106	end FlatSections

108	section RelCurveFlat
109	
110	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
111	variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
112	
113	/-- **The relative curve is flat over its test base.** `(snd C (overSpec k R)).left` is the
114	base change of `C.hom` along `(overSpec k R).hom` (`Over.isPullback_left`), and every
115	structure morphism to the spectrum of a field is flat (`flat_hom_over_field`). -/
116	instance instFlatRelCurveHom : AlgebraicGeometry.Flat (relCurve C R ↘ Spec (.of R)) :=
117	  AlgebraicGeometry.Flat.isStableUnderBaseChange.of_isPullback
118	    (Over.isPullback_left C (overSpec k R)) inferInstance
119	
120	/-- **Flat sections on an arbitrary affine open of the relative curve** — the widened
121	(c1)-flatness input, with no chart and no freeness. -/
122	theorem flat_sections_isAffineOpen {V : (relCurve C R).Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
123	    Module.Flat R Γ(relCurve C R, V) :=
124	  flat_sections_of_flat_hom R (relCurve C R) hV
125

128	/-! ## The widened cover datum -/
129	
130	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
131	variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
132	variable (π : C.left ⟶ P1 k)
133	
134	/-- **The widened cover datum** (R2, human decision I-0492): finitely many **arbitrary
135	affine opens** of the relative curve that **jointly** cover it.
136	
137	Contrast with `FinCoverData`, which this replaces on the certificate side: there is no `h₀`,
138	no `h₁`, no `a₀`/`a₁`, no `partition₀`/`partition₁`, no `Sum` index, and above all no typing
139	of a piece into a pinned chart.  The chart-wise partitions of unity are exactly what upgraded
140	per-piece swallow-or-miss to a chart statement, and they are gone deliberately; the two-chart
141	structure the Θ-layer needs is carried separately (see `ChartTyping` below), never by the
142	certificate clauses.
143	
144	`Type u`, like `FinCoverData`, so a functor value can quotient it. -/
145	structure AffCoverData : Type u where
146	  /-- The number of pieces. -/
147	  m : ℕ
148	  /-- The pieces: arbitrary opens of the relative curve, made affine by `isAffineOpen`. -/
149	  pieces : Fin m → (relCurve C R).Opens
150	  /-- Every piece is affine — the only geometric demand the certificate layer makes. -/
151	  isAffineOpen : ∀ j, IsAffineOpen (pieces j)
152	  /-- The pieces cover the curve JOINTLY.  This replaces the two chart-wise partitions of
153	  unity, and it is the whole structural content of the widening. -/
154	  cover : (⨆ j, pieces j) = ⊤
155	
156	namespace AffCoverData
157	
158	variable {C R π} (D : AffCoverData C R)
159	
160	/-- The gluing index of the widened datum: a bare `Fin`, with no two-sided structure. -/
161	abbrev index : Type := Fin D.m
162	
163	/-- **Every point lies in a piece.** Under `FinCoverData` this came from `relCover_sup`
164	together with the two partitions of unity; here it is exactly the joint covering field —
165	obligation I-0492 4(ii) discharged in one line rather than silently supplied by the typing. -/
166	lemma exists_mem_pieces (z : relCurve C R) : ∃ j : D.index, z ∈ D.pieces j := by
167	  have hz : z ∈ (⨆ j, D.pieces j) := by rw [D.cover]; trivial
168	  exact Opens.mem_iSup.mp hz
169	
170	/-- The pieces are affine opens — by fiat now, rather than as basic opens of an affine
171	chart. -/
172	lemma isAffineOpen_pieces (j : D.index) : IsAffineOpen (D.pieces j) :=
173	  D.isAffineOpen j
174	
175	/-- **Flatness of the piece section rings over the test ring.** The widened replacement for
176	`FinCoverData.flat_sections_pieces`, which localized a FREE pinned-chart ring; here it is the
177	flat structure morphism of the relative curve read on an affine open. -/
178	theorem flat_sections_pieces (j : D.index) :
179	    Module.Flat R Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j) :=
180	  flat_sections_isAffineOpen C R (D.isAffineOpen j)
181	
182	/-- Piece overlaps are affine (the relative curve is separated over `Spec R`, being proper),
183	so the overlap section rings are flat too — the widened
184	`FinCoverData.flat_sections_pieces_inf`. -/
185	theorem flat_sections_pieces_inf (i j : D.index)
186	    (hinf : IsAffineOpen (D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j)) :
187	    Module.Flat R Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces i ⊓ D.pieces j) :=
188	  flat_sections_isAffineOpen C R hinf
189	
190	end AffCoverData
191	
192	/-! ## The optional chart typing, for the Θ-layer only -/
193	
194	/-- The pinned chart of a given side, spelled here so this file needs no import from the
195	Θ-layer (it agrees with `relPinnedChart` by `rfl`). -/
196	noncomputable def pinnedChartOfSide [IsAffineHom π] (b : Bool) : (relCurve C R).Opens :=
197	  bif b then (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ else (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
198	
199	/-- **A chart typing of a widened cover**: an assignment of each piece to one of the two
200	pinned `P¹` charts, containing it.  This is what the Θ-twisting unit genuinely needs (the
201	theta cocycle lives on `V₀ ⊓ V₁`), and it is deliberately a SEPARATE datum: no certificate
202	clause and no locally-certified predicate may require it.  Keeping it separate is what stops
203	the old fixed-pair typing from being smuggled back in through a field. -/
204	structure ChartTyping [IsAffineHom π] (D : AffCoverData C R) where
205	  /-- Which pinned chart the piece is assigned to. -/
206	  side : D.index → Bool
207	  /-- The piece is contained in its assigned chart. -/
208	  piece_le : ∀ j, D.pieces j ≤ pinnedChartOfSide C R π (side j)
209	
210	/-! ## Migration: old cover data instantiates the widened datum -/
211	
212	namespace FinCoverData
213	
214	variable {C R π} [IsAffineHom π] (D : FinCoverData C R π)
215	
216	/-- **The migration map.** An old chart-typed `FinCoverData` gives a widened
217	`AffCoverData`: reindex `Fin m₀ ⊕ Fin m₁` through `finSumFinEquiv`, the pieces are affine as
218	basic opens of the affine pinned charts, and the joint cover follows from the two chart-wise
219	covers together with `relCover_sup`.
220	
221	The point of this lemma is that widening costs nothing landed: every existing construction of
222	cover data still produces a legal widened datum.  The converse fails, and that is exactly the
223	content of R2. -/
224	noncomputable def toAffCoverData : AffCoverData C R where
225	  m := D.m₀ + D.m₁
226	  pieces := fun j => D.pieces (finSumFinEquiv.symm j)
227	  isAffineOpen := fun j => by
228	    rcases finSumFinEquiv.symm j with i | i
229	    · rw [FinCoverData.pieces_inl]
230	      exact (relCover_isAffineOpen₀ C R (fiberTwoCover π)).basicOpen _
231	    · rw [FinCoverData.pieces_inr]
232	      exact (relCover_isAffineOpen₁ C R (fiberTwoCover π)).basicOpen _
233	  cover := by
234	    refine top_le_iff.mp fun z _ => ?_
235	    -- every point is in a pinned chart, and each chart is covered by its own pieces
236	    have hz : z ∈ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
237	        ⊔ (relCover C R (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ := by
238	      rw [relCover_sup]; trivial
239	    have key : ∃ i : D.index, z ∈ D.pieces i := by
240	      rcases Opens.mem_sup.mp hz with h | h
241	      · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp (D.cover₀ h)
242	        exact ⟨Sum.inl i, hi⟩
243	      · obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp (D.cover₁ h)
244	        exact ⟨Sum.inr i, hi⟩
245	    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := key
246	    exact Opens.mem_iSup.mpr ⟨finSumFinEquiv i, by
247	      simpa only [Equiv.symm_apply_apply] using hi⟩
248	
249	@[simp]
250	lemma toAffCoverData_pieces (j : Fin (D.m₀ + D.m₁)) :
251	    D.toAffCoverData.pieces j = D.pieces (finSumFinEquiv.symm j) := rfl
252	
253	/-- The canonical chart typing of a migrated datum: chart-0 pieces are basic opens of `V₀`,
254	chart-1 pieces of `V₁`. -/
255	noncomputable def toChartTyping : ChartTyping C R π D.toAffCoverData where
256	  side := fun j => (finSumFinEquiv.symm j).isRight
257	  piece_le := fun j => by
258	    rw [toAffCoverData_pieces]
259	    rcases h : finSumFinEquiv.symm j with i | i
260	    · rw [FinCoverData.pieces_inl]
261	      exact (relCurve C R).basicOpen_le (D.h₀ i)
262	    · rw [FinCoverData.pieces_inr]
263	      exact (relCurve C R).basicOpen_le (D.h₁ i)
264	
265	end FinCoverData
266	
267	end AlgebraicGeometry

8	/-!
9	# Base change of certified divisor families and `DivFam.mapAlg` (DD-2 stage S2)
10	
11	The base-changed divisor adaptation and the divisor-functor map on classes along an
12	ARBITRARY test change `R → R'` (`informal/spec-dd-2.md` §2) — the resolution of the
13	DD-1 pt-transport seam: the carrier's pointwise refinement clause `eqn_rel` is
14	point-free (the `DivEq` spelling), so it pulls back along arbitrary morphisms through
15	`Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE`, with no surjectivity hypothesis on the comparison
16	`relCurveMap C R R'`.
17	
18	* `Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback` — divisor equality is stable under pullback
19	  (common refinement and units pull back), so the map descends to classes.
20	* `DivisorAdaptation.pullback` — **the base-changed adaptation**: base-changed cover
21	  data carrying the pulled equations; `eqn_rel` transports clause-for-clause through
22	  `unitsAppLE` (the `divEq_pullback` pattern).
23	* `DivisorAdaptation.isCertified_pullback` — **certified base change**: the transported
24	  certificate, assembling the (c1)–(c4) clause transports of
25	  `DivisorFamilyPullbackCert`/`DivisorFamilyPullbackGlued` (all fields are
26	  definitionally the pulled apparatus).
27	* `CertifiedDivisorFamily.mapAlg`, `DivFam.mapAlg` — **the divisor-functor map**
28	  `DivFam C R π n → DivFam C R' π n` on representatives and on classes
29	  (`Quotient.lift`, descent by `divEq_pullback`), with the Abel-hook class law
30	  `DivFam.picClass_mapAlg` (`𝒪(f*D) = f*𝒪(D)`).
31	* `DivFam.mapAlg_id`, `DivFam.mapAlg_comp` — **the functor laws** (spec §2, functor-laws
32	  rows): base change along the identity tower is the identity, and base change composes
33	  over a tower `R → R' → R''`. Representative level:
34	  `Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback_id`/`divEq_pullback_pullback` (unit `1`), fed by
35	  the comparison identities `relCurveMap_id`/`relCurveMap_comp` (with the instance-based
36	  `overSpecMap_id`/`overSpecMap_comp`), landed here for the S3 vehicle.
37	-/

60	/-- `appLE` of a local equation at propositionally equal base points. -/
61	private lemma appLE_eqn_congr {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (E : Y.LocalEquations)
62	    {x₁ x₂ : Y} (hx : x₁ = x₂) {W : X.Opens}
63	    (e₁ : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ E.cover.opens x₁) (e₂ : W ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ E.cover.opens x₂) :
64	    (f.appLE (E.cover.opens x₁) W e₁).hom (E.eqn x₁) =
65	      (f.appLE (E.cover.opens x₂) W e₂).hom (E.eqn x₂) := by
66	  subst hx
67	  rfl

69	/-- **Divisor equality is stable under pullback**: a common refinement with pointwise
70	units pulls back to a common refinement with pulled units (`Scheme.Hom.unitsAppLE`). -/
71	theorem divEq_pullback {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) {d₁ d₂ : X.LocalEquations}
72	    (h : DivEq d₁ d₂)
73	    (hreg₁ : ∀ (y z : Y) (hz : z ∈ (d₁.cover.pullback f).opens y),
74	      (Y.presheaf.germ ((d₁.cover.pullback f).opens y) z hz).hom (pullbackEqn f d₁ y)
75	        ∈ nonZeroDivisors (Y.presheaf.stalk z))
76	    (hreg₂ : ∀ (y z : Y) (hz : z ∈ (d₂.cover.pullback f).opens y),
77	      (Y.presheaf.germ ((d₂.cover.pullback f).opens y) z hz).hom (pullbackEqn f d₂ y)
78	        ∈ nonZeroDivisors (Y.presheaf.stalk z)) :
79	    DivEq (d₁.pullback f hreg₁) (d₂.pullback f hreg₂) := by
80	  obtain ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, H⟩ := h
81	  refine ⟨𝒲.pullback f, fun y => Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono f (h₁ (f.base y)),
82	    fun y => Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono f (h₂ (f.base y)), fun y => ?_⟩
83	  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := H (f.base y)
84	  have hle : (𝒲.pullback f).opens y ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ 𝒲.opens (f.base y) := le_rfl
85	  refine ⟨f.unitsAppLE (𝒲.opens (f.base y)) ((𝒲.pullback f).opens y) hle u, ?_⟩
86	  -- both sides collapse to `appLE` of the base equations at the pulled member
87	  have hres₁ : (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE
88	      (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono f (h₁ (f.base y)) :
89	        (𝒲.pullback f).opens y ≤ (d₁.cover.pullback f).opens y)).op).hom
90	      ((d₁.pullback f hreg₁).eqn y) =
91	      (f.appLE (d₁.cover.opens (f.base y)) ((𝒲.pullback f).opens y)
92	        (hle.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono f (h₁ (f.base y))))).hom
93	        (d₁.eqn (f.base y)) :=
94	    pullbackEqn_res f d₁ y _
95	  have hres₂ : (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE
96	      (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono f (h₂ (f.base y)) :
97	        (𝒲.pullback f).opens y ≤ (d₂.cover.pullback f).opens y)).op).hom
98	      ((d₂.pullback f hreg₂).eqn y) =
99	      (f.appLE (d₂.cover.opens (f.base y)) ((𝒲.pullback f).opens y)
100	        (hle.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_mono f (h₂ (f.base y))))).hom
101	        (d₂.eqn (f.base y)) :=
102	    pullbackEqn_res f d₂ y _
103	  -- the pre-restriction collapse on both sides
104	  have e₁ := congr(($(Scheme.Hom.map_appLE f hle (homOfLE (h₁ (f.base y))).op)).hom
105	    (d₁.eqn (f.base y)))
106	  have e₂ := congr(($(Scheme.Hom.map_appLE f hle (homOfLE (h₂ (f.base y))).op)).hom
107	    (d₂.eqn (f.base y)))
108	  -- transport the unit relation through `appLE`
109	  have key := congrArg (f.appLE (𝒲.opens (f.base y)) ((𝒲.pullback f).opens y) hle).hom hu
110	  rw [map_mul] at key
111	  refine hres₁.trans (e₁.symm.trans (key.trans (congrArg₂ (· * ·) rfl
112	    (e₂.trans hres₂.symm))))
113	
114	/-- **Pullback along the identity preserves the divisor**: a system pulled back along a
115	morphism (propositionally) equal to `𝟙 X` is `DivEq` to the original, with unit `1` —
116	the pulled equation collapses to the restricted equation once `appLE` at the identity
117	becomes restriction. Representative input of the functor law `DivFam.mapAlg_id`. -/
118	theorem divEq_pullback_id {X : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ X} (hf : f = 𝟙 X)
119	    (E : X.LocalEquations) (hreg) :
120	    DivEq (E.pullback f hreg) E := by
121	  subst hf
122	  refine ⟨E.cover.pullback (𝟙 X), fun y => le_rfl, fun y => le_of_eq rfl,
123	    fun y => ⟨1, ?_⟩⟩
124	  rw [Units.val_one, one_mul]
125	  -- `appLE` at the identity is restriction, definitionally; the collapse lemma
126	  -- `pullbackEqn_res` is then the whole clause.
127	  exact pullbackEqn_res (𝟙 X) E y le_rfl
128	
129	/-- **Pullback of a divisor composes**: pulling back in two stages along `g` then `f` is
130	`DivEq` to pulling back along a morphism (propositionally) equal to the composite
131	`g ≫ f`, with unit `1` — the two covers agree (preimage of preimage is preimage of the
132	composite) and the equations agree on the nose (`Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE`).
133	Representative input of the functor law `DivFam.mapAlg_comp`. -/
134	theorem divEq_pullback_pullback {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} {f : Y ⟶ X} {g : Z ⟶ Y} {h : Z ⟶ X}
135	    (hgf : g ≫ f = h) (E : X.LocalEquations) (hreg₁) (hreg₂) (hreg₃) :
136	    DivEq ((E.pullback f hreg₁).pullback g hreg₂) (E.pullback h hreg₃) := by
137	  subst hgf
138	  have hcov : ∀ z : Z, ((E.cover.pullback f).pullback g).opens z ≤
139	      (E.cover.pullback (g ≫ f)).opens z := fun z =>
140	    le_of_eq (by
141	      rw [Scheme.PointedCover.pullback_opens, Scheme.PointedCover.pullback_opens,
142	        Scheme.PointedCover.pullback_opens, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage,
143	        Scheme.Hom.comp_apply])
144	  refine ⟨(E.cover.pullback f).pullback g, fun z => le_rfl, hcov, fun z => ⟨1, ?_⟩⟩
145	  rw [Units.val_one, one_mul]
146	  -- the two-stage pulled equation is `appLE ≫ appLE` of the base equation, which is
147	  -- `appLE` of the composite (`Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE`); both restriction
148	  -- collapses are `pullbackEqn_res`
149	  have h2 := congr(($(Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE g f
150	    (E.cover.opens (f.base (g.base z))) ((E.cover.pullback f).opens (g.base z))
151	    (((E.cover.pullback f).pullback g).opens z) le_rfl le_rfl)).hom
152	      (E.eqn (f.base (g.base z))))
153	  exact (pullbackEqn_res g (E.pullback f hreg₁) z le_rfl).trans
154	    (h2.trans (pullbackEqn_res (g ≫ f) E z (hcov z)).symm)
155

192	          (A.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y')) :=

197	        (A.pulledEquations R' hproj).cover.opens y') hle u, ?_⟩
198	    -- LHS: the restricted pulled equation collapses to `appLE` of the piece equation

201	          (A.pulledEquations R' hproj).cover.opens y' ≤
202	          (A.toFinCoverData.baseChange R').pieces j)).op).hom (A.pulledEqn R' j) =

212	        (A.toFinCoverData.baseChange R').pieces j ⊓
213	          (A.pulledEquations R' hproj).cover.opens y' ≤
214	          (A.pulledEquations R' hproj).cover.opens y')).op).hom
215	        ((A.pulledEquations R' hproj).eqn y') =
216	        ((relCurveMap C R R').appLE (d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y'))

137	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))) :=
138	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
139	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, IsLocalization.map_comp,
140	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq])
141	  haveI : IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away (g i))
142	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))) :=
143	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
144	      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k R (Localization.Away (g i)),
145	        ← RingHom.comp_assoc,
146	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R (Localization.Away (g i))
147	          (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))),
148	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k R
149	          (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i)))])
150	  -- witness transport along `R → Localization.Away (g i) → the pushed chart`
151	  have hW := G.divEq_mapAlg_pullback (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i)))
152	    (hloc'.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors
153	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i)))) hGdiv
154	  -- the composite collapse through the `R'`-side factorization
155	  have hcomp₂ : relCurveMap C R' (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i)))
156	      ≫ relCurveMap C R R'
157	      = relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))) :=
158	    relCurveMap_comp (R' := R') (R'' := Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i)))
159	  have hstep := Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback_pullback hcomp₂ d hreg
160	    (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
161	      (relCurveMap C R' (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))))
162	      (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R R') hreg))
163	    (hloc'.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors
164	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))))
165	  exact ⟨G.mapAlg (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))) n, hW.trans hstep.symm⟩

167	/-! ## The total divisor-functor map on locally certified classes -/
168	
169	variable (n : ℕ)
170	
171	/-- **The total divisor-functor map on locally certified classes** along an ARBITRARY
172	test change (`informal/spec-dd-2.md`, Addendum 2): pull back the representative (the
173	mapAlg-hreg engine discharges regularity) and transport the local certificates. Well
174	defined by `divEq_pullback`. -/
175	noncomputable def DivFamZar.mapAlg : DivFamZar C R π n → DivFamZar C R' π n :=
176	  Quotient.lift
177	    (fun dp : {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations // IsLocallyCertified C R π n d} =>
178	      DivFamZar.mk (dp.1.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')
179	          (dp.2.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors R'))
180	        (dp.2.pullback R' _))
181	    (fun _ _ h => DivFamZar.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr
182	      (Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback (relCurveMap C R R') h _ _))
183	
184	@[simp]
185	lemma DivFamZar.mapAlg_mk (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations)
186	    (hd : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d) :
187	    DivFamZar.mapAlg R' n (DivFamZar.mk d hd)
188	      = DivFamZar.mk (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')
189	          (hd.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors R'))
190	        (hd.pullback R' _) :=
191	  rfl
192	
193	/-- **The Abel-hook class law at the Zar level**: the divisor-functor map intertwines
194	the Picard classes with the Čech-Picard pullback, `𝒪(f*D) = f*𝒪(D)`. -/
195	lemma DivFamZar.picClass_mapAlg (F : DivFamZar C R π n) :
196	    (DivFamZar.mapAlg R' n F).picClass =
197	      Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C R R') F.picClass := by
198	  induction F using Quotient.inductionOn with
199	  | h d => exact Scheme.LocalEquations.picClass_pullback (relCurveMap C R R') d.1 _
200	
201	/-- **`toZar` intertwines the two total maps**: base change of a globally certified
202	class agrees with base change of its locally certified image — both representatives
203	are the pulled system (with proof-irrelevant regularity witnesses). -/
204	lemma DivFam.toZar_mapAlg (F : DivFam C R π n) :
205	    (DivFam.mapAlg R' n F).toZar = DivFamZar.mapAlg R' n F.toZar := by
206	  induction F using Quotient.inductionOn with
207	  | h F => exact DivFamZar.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr (Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_refl _)
208	
209	/-- **The identity functor law** at the Zar level: base change along the identity
210	tower is the identity (`divEq_pullback_id` at `relCurveMap_id`). -/
211	lemma DivFamZar.mapAlg_id (F : DivFamZar C R π n) : DivFamZar.mapAlg R n F = F := by
212	  induction F using Quotient.inductionOn with
213	  | h d =>
214	      exact DivFamZar.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr
215	        (Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback_id relCurveMap_id d.1 _)
216	
217	variable (R'' : Type u) [CommRing R''] [Algebra k R''] [Algebra R R''] [Algebra R' R'']
218	variable [IsScalarTower k R R''] [IsScalarTower k R' R''] [IsScalarTower R R' R'']
219	
220	/-- **The composition functor law** at the Zar level: base change composes over a
221	tower `R → R' → R''` (`divEq_pullback_pullback` at `relCurveMap_comp`). -/
222	lemma DivFamZar.mapAlg_comp (F : DivFamZar C R π n) :
223	    DivFamZar.mapAlg R'' n (DivFamZar.mapAlg R' n F) = DivFamZar.mapAlg R'' n F := by
224	  induction F using Quotient.inductionOn with
225	  | h d =>
226	      exact DivFamZar.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr
227	        (Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback_pullback
228	          (relCurveMap_comp (R' := R') (R'' := R'')) d.1 _ _ _)
229	
230	end Transport

232	/-! ## Zariski separation at the Zar level -/
233	
234	/-- **Zariski separation of the locally certified divisor functor**
235	(`informal/spec-dd-2.md`, Addendum 2 — the S5b separation keystone): two locally
236	certified divisor classes over `R` agreeing under `DivFamZar.mapAlg` on every member
237	of a finite covering family of localizations agree. Certificates play no role in
238	equality: the statement reduces verbatim to the S4 `DivEq`-level engine
239	`divEq_of_divEq_pullback`, with regularity along the chart immersions free (Kit). -/
240	theorem DivFamZar.eq_of_away_eq {n : ℕ} {ι : Type u} [Finite ι] (g : ι → R)
241	    (S : ι → Type u)
242	    [∀ i, CommRing (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra k (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra R (S i)]
243	    [∀ i, IsScalarTower k R (S i)] [∀ i, IsLocalization.Away (g i) (S i)]
244	    (hg : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤) {F G : DivFamZar C R π n}
245	    (h : ∀ i, DivFamZar.mapAlg (S i) n F = DivFamZar.mapAlg (S i) n G) :
246	    F = G := by
247	  haveI : ∀ i, IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (S i)) := fun i =>
248	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (S i) (g i)
249	  revert h
250	  refine Quotient.inductionOn₂ F G fun d₁ d₂ h => ?_
251	  refine DivFamZar.mk_eq_mk_iff.mpr ?_
252	  refine Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_of_divEq_pullback
253	    (fun i => relCurveMap C R (S i))
254	    (fun y => exists_relCurveMap_base_eq C R g S hg y)
255	    (fun i => d₁.2.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors (S i))
256	    (fun i => d₂.2.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors (S i))
257	    (fun i => ?_)
258	  exact DivFamZar.mk_eq_mk_iff.mp (h i)
259

10	/-!
11	# Locally certified divisor families: the `DivFamZar` carrier (DD-2 stage S5b)
12	
13	The Addendum-2 repair of the divisor-functor carrier (`informal/spec-dd-2.md`,
14	Addendum 2): the globally-certified `DivFam` is not a Zariski sheaf — the diagonal
15	divisor over `Γ(C \ pt)` is certifiable on a basic-open cover of the base but carries
16	no global certificate — so the faithful functor value is the **locally certified**
17	quotient `DivFamZar`. The generic germ-regularity engines live in
18	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarKit`.
19	
20	* `AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocallyCertified` — the Addendum-2 frozen pin: a span-⊤ family
21	  `g : Fin m → R` with certified divisor families over `Localization.Away (g i)`
22	  divisor-equal to the pulled system; `hreg` is discharged by the Kit's open-immersion
23	  lemma, with the S4 instance provided by `haveI`.
24	* `IsLocallyCertified.of_divEq` — the pin respects divisor equality.
25	* `CertifiedDivisorFamily.isLocallyCertified` — a global certificate is a local one
26	  (trivial cover `g = ![1]`; the certified part is `mapAlg` to `Localization.Away 1`,
27	  whose equations ARE the pulled system on the nose).
28	* `IsLocallyCertified.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors` — **the mapAlg-hreg
29	  engine**: a locally certified system has regular pulled equations along the
30	  comparison of an ARBITRARY test tower `R → R'` — regularity is germ-local, each germ
31	  sits over a chart `Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))` of `R'`, where the
32	  local certificate's regularity transports through its `DivEq` and the landed
33	  certificate-based pullback regularity.
34	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar` — the quotient of locally certified systems by
35	  `DivEq`, with `mk`, `mk_eq_mk_iff`, `picClass`, and `DivFam.toZar`.
36	
37	Total `DivFamZar.mapAlg` and the Zariski keystones are
38	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarMapAlg` / `…ZarGlue`.
39	-/

58	/-! ## The locally certified pin -/
59	
60	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
61	variable (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
62	variable (π : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsAffineHom π]
63	
64	/-- **The Addendum-2 frozen pin** (`informal/spec-dd-2.md`, Addendum 2): a
65	local-equation system on the relative curve is *locally certified* in degree `n` if
66	some span-⊤ family `g : Fin m → R` carries certified divisor families over the
67	localizations `Localization.Away (g i)` that are divisor-equal to the pulled system.
68	The pullback's regularity hypothesis is discharged once and for all by the Kit's
69	open-immersion lemma — the comparison of an away localization is an open immersion
70	(the S4 instance, provided by `haveI`). -/
71	def IsLocallyCertified (n : ℕ) (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) : Prop :=
72	  ∃ (m : ℕ) (g : Fin m → R), Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤ ∧
73	    ∀ i : Fin m,
74	      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) :=
75	        isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (g i)) (g i)
76	      ∃ G : CertifiedDivisorFamily C (Localization.Away (g i)) π n,
77	        Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq G.eqns
78	          (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i)))
79	            (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
80	              (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) d))
81	
82	variable {C R π}
83	
84	/-- **The locally certified pin respects divisor equality**: the local `DivEq`s
85	transport through `divEq_pullback` (regularity along the chart immersions is free). -/
86	theorem IsLocallyCertified.of_divEq {n : ℕ} {d d' : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
87	    (hd : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d) (h : Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d d') :
88	    IsLocallyCertified C R π n d' := by
89	  obtain ⟨m, g, hg, hG⟩ := hd
90	  refine ⟨m, g, hg, fun i => ?_⟩
91	  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) :=
92	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (g i)) (g i)
93	  obtain ⟨G, hGdiv⟩ := hG i
94	  exact ⟨G, hGdiv.trans
95	    (Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i)))
96	      h _ _)⟩
97	
98	/-- **A global certificate is a local one** (the trivial cover `g = ![1]`): the
99	certified part over `Localization.Away (1 : R)` is `mapAlg` of the family, whose
100	equations are the pulled system on the nose (`pulledEquations` IS the pullback along
101	the comparison; the regularity proofs are proof-irrelevant). -/
102	theorem CertifiedDivisorFamily.isLocallyCertified {n : ℕ}
103	    (F : CertifiedDivisorFamily C R π n) : IsLocallyCertified C R π n F.eqns := by
104	  refine ⟨1, fun _ => (1 : R), ?_, fun i => ?_⟩
105	  · have hrange : Set.range (fun _ : Fin 1 => (1 : R)) = {1} := Set.range_const
106	    rw [hrange, Ideal.span_singleton_one]
107	  · haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (1 : R))) :=
108	      isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (1 : R)) 1
109	    exact ⟨F.mapAlg (Localization.Away (1 : R)) n,
110	      Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_refl _⟩

112	/-! ## The mapAlg-hreg engine -/
113	
114	section MapAlgHreg
115	
116	variable {n : ℕ} {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
117	variable (R' : Type u) [CommRing R'] [Algebra k R'] [Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R']
118	
119	/-- **The mapAlg-hreg engine** (S5b): a locally certified system has regular pulled
120	equations along the comparison of an ARBITRARY test tower `R → R'`. Regularity is
121	germ-local on the curve: the charts `Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i))` cover
122	`relCurve C R'` by open immersions; over each, the composite comparison factors
123	through the certified chart `Localization.Away (g i)`, where the certificate's
124	pullback regularity (`DivisorAdaptation.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors`)
125	transports through the recorded `DivEq`. -/
126	theorem IsLocallyCertified.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors
127	    (hloc : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d)
128	    (y z : relCurve C R') (hz : z ∈ (d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens y) :
129	    ((relCurve C R').presheaf.germ ((d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens y)
130	        z hz).hom (Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn (relCurveMap C R R') d y)
131	      ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C R').presheaf.stalk z) := by
132	  classical
133	  obtain ⟨m, g, hg, hG⟩ := hloc
134	  -- the away charts of `R'` at the pushed cover, and their immersions
135	  haveI himm : ∀ i : ULift.{u} (Fin m),
136	      IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R'
137	        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))) := fun i =>
138	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R'
139	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))
140	  -- the pushed family spans the unit ideal of `R'`
141	  have hspan' : Ideal.span (Set.range
142	      (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) = ⊤ := by
143	    have hrange : Set.range (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => algebraMap R R' (g i.down))
144	        = algebraMap R R' '' Set.range g := by
145	      ext x
146	      constructor
147	      · rintro ⟨i, rfl⟩
148	        exact ⟨g i.down, ⟨i.down, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
149	      · rintro ⟨-, ⟨j, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
150	        exact ⟨⟨j⟩, rfl⟩
151	    rw [hrange, ← Ideal.map_span, hg, Ideal.map_top]
152	  refine Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_immersion_cover
153	    (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => relCurveMap C R'
154	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))))
155	    (fun y' => exists_relCurveMap_base_eq C R'
156	      (fun i : ULift.{u} (Fin m) => algebraMap R R' (g i.down))
157	      (fun i => Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) hspan' y')
158	    (relCurveMap C R R') d (fun i ζ => ?_) y z hz
159	  -- over the chart at `g i`: factor the composite through the certified localization
160	  obtain ⟨G, hGdiv⟩ := hG i.down
161	  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i.down))) :=
162	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (g i.down)) (g i.down)
163	  -- the away map `Localization.Away (g i) → Localization.Away (φ (g i))` as an
164	  -- algebra tower
165	  letI : Algebra (Localization.Away (g i.down))
166	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
167	    (IsLocalization.map (M := Submonoid.powers (g i.down))
168	      (T := Submonoid.powers (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
169	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) (algebraMap R R')
170	      (by
171	        rintro x ⟨e, rfl⟩
172	        use e
173	        simp)).toAlgebra
174	  haveI : IsScalarTower R (Localization.Away (g i.down))
175	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
176	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
177	      rw [RingHom.algebraMap_toAlgebra, IsLocalization.map_comp,
178	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq])
179	  haveI : IsScalarTower k (Localization.Away (g i.down))
180	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
181	    IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq' (by
182	      rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k R (Localization.Away (g i.down)),
183	        ← RingHom.comp_assoc,
184	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq R (Localization.Away (g i.down))
185	          (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))),
186	        ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq k R
187	          (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))])
188	  -- the comparison triangle through the two factorizations of `C_{T i} → C_R`
189	  have hcomp₁ : relCurveMap C (Localization.Away (g i.down))
190	        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
191	      ≫ relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i.down))
192	      = relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
193	    relCurveMap_comp (R' := Localization.Away (g i.down))
194	      (R'' := Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
195	  have hcomp₂ : relCurveMap C R' (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
196	      ≫ relCurveMap C R R'
197	      = relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))) :=
198	    relCurveMap_comp (R' := R')
199	      (R'' := Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
200	  have step1 := Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_congr hcomp₂ d ζ
201	  have step2 := Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_comp hcomp₁ d
202	    (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
203	      (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i.down))) d) ζ
204	  have hfinal := Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_self_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_divEq
205	    (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away (g i.down))
206	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))) hGdiv ζ
207	    (G.adaptation.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors
208	      (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down)))
209	      G.certified.projective_colength ζ ζ
210	      ((G.eqns.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C (Localization.Away (g i.down))
211	        (Localization.Away (algebraMap R R' (g i.down))))).mem_opens ζ))
212	  exact ((step1.trans step2).symm ▸ hfinal)
213	
214	end MapAlgHreg

216	/-! ## The locally certified divisor-functor value -/
217	
218	variable (C R π)
219	variable (n : ℕ)
220	
221	/-- The divisor-equality setoid on locally certified systems (Addendum 2's mirror of
222	`divFamSetoid`): the underlying local-equation systems cut the same divisor; the local
223	certificates are per-representative data and do not enter the relation. -/
224	def divFamZarSetoid : Setoid {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations //
225	    IsLocallyCertified C R π n d} where
226	  r d₁ d₂ := Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d₁.1 d₂.1
227	  iseqv :=
228	    ⟨fun d => Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_refl d.1,
229	     fun h => h.symm, fun h h' => h.trans h'⟩
230	
231	/-- **The locally certified divisor-functor value on the affine test `R`**
232	(`informal/spec-dd-2.md`, Addendum 2): locally certified local-equation systems of
233	degree `n` up to divisor equality. This is the carrier on which the divisor functor is
234	a Zariski sheaf — the globally certified `DivFam` remains the building block. -/
235	def DivFamZar : Type u := Quotient (divFamZarSetoid C R π n)
236	
237	namespace DivFamZar
238	
239	variable {C R π n}
240	
241	/-- The class of a locally certified system. -/
242	def mk (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) (hd : IsLocallyCertified C R π n d) :
243	    DivFamZar C R π n :=
244	  Quotient.mk (divFamZarSetoid C R π n) ⟨d, hd⟩
245

/-! ## The relative-curve comparison of a localization is an open immersion -/

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]

section RelCurveAway

variable (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]

section OneLocalization

variable (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] [Algebra R S] [IsScalarTower k R S]

/-- **The relative-curve comparison of a localization is an open immersion**: for
`IsLocalization.Away f S`, the comparison `relCurveMap C R S : C_S ⟶ C_R` is the
whiskering of the basic open immersion `Spec S ⟶ Spec R`, hence its base change along
the projection (`Over.isOpenImmersion_whiskerLeft`). -/
theorem isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away (f : R) [IsLocalization.Away f S] :
    IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R S) := by
  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (overSpecMap (k := k) R S).left := by
    rw [overSpecMap_left]
    exact IsOpenImmersion.of_isLocalization f
  exact Over.isOpenImmersion_whiskerLeft C (overSpecMap (k := k) R S)

end OneLocalization

section Family

variable {ι : Type u} (g : ι → R) (S : ι → Type u) [∀ i, CommRing (S i)]
  [∀ i, Algebra k (S i)] [∀ i, Algebra R (S i)] [∀ i, IsScalarTower k R (S i)]
  [∀ i, IsLocalization.Away (g i) (S i)]

/-- **The point lift for a span-⊤ family of localizations**: every point of the
relative curve `C_R` lifts to the relative curve of some localization `S i`. The
structure image of the point in `Spec R` avoids some `g i` (the `g i` generate the unit
ideal, so no prime contains all of them), hence lies in the image of
`Spec (S i) ⟶ Spec R` (`PrimeSpectrum.localization_away_comap_range`), and the whisker
square is a pullback of topological images (`Over.range_whiskerLeft`). -/
theorem exists_relCurveMap_base_eq (hg : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤)
    (y : relCurve C R) :
    ∃ (i : ι) (z : relCurve C (S i)), (relCurveMap C R (S i)).base z = y := by
  classical
  -- the structure image of `y` in `Spec R` avoids some `g i`
  have hexists : ∃ i, g i ∉
      (show PrimeSpectrum R from (snd C (overSpec k R)).left.base y).asIdeal := by
    by_contra hall
    have hle : Ideal.span (Set.range g) ≤
        (show PrimeSpectrum R from (snd C (overSpec k R)).left.base y).asIdeal := by
      rw [Ideal.span_le]
      rintro _ ⟨i, rfl⟩
      exact of_not_not fun hc => hall ⟨i, hc⟩
    rw [hg] at hle
    exact (show PrimeSpectrum R from
      (snd C (overSpec k R)).left.base y).isPrime.ne_top (top_le_iff.mp hle)
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hexists

55	The heavy lifting is mathlib's `pushoutSection` API

57	canonical map `Γ(X, Uₓ) ⊗[Γ(S, Uₛ)] Γ(T, Uₜ) ⟶ Γ(X ×ₛ T, ...)` is an isomorphism for

248	theorem Over.isPushout_algebraMap_sections {V : X.left.Opens}
249	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left)) :
250	    IsPushout (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k Γ(X.left, V)))
251	      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A))
252	      ((fst X (overSpec k A)).left.appLE V ((fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl)
253	      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫
254	        (snd X (overSpec k A)).left.appLE ⊤ ((fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)

257	    (isAffineOpen_top_overSpec k A) hV hV').of_iso
258	    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)) (Iso.refl _) (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)) (Iso.refl _)

262	  · have h : (overSpec k A).hom.appLE ⊤ ⊤ (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (overSpec k A).hom).ge =

264	      Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app _
265	    rw [h, overSpec_hom]

272	`Γ(X.left, V) ⊗[k] A ≅ Γ((X ⊗ Spec A).left, fst⁻¹ V)` for a qcqs open `V ⊆ X.left`.

275	noncomputable def Over.sectionsBaseChangeIso {V : X.left.Opens}
276	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left)) :
277	    CommRingCat.of (Γ(X.left, V) ⊗[k] A) ≅
278	      Γ((X ⊗ overSpec k A).left, (fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
279	  (CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct k Γ(X.left, V) A).isoIsPushout _ _

282	/-- **Base change of sections** (brick 1 of the separatedness ledger, design §4.4): for `X`
283	over the field `k`, a commutative `k`-algebra `A` and a qcqs open `V ⊆ X.left`, the ring
284	equivalence `Γ(X.left, V) ⊗[k] A ≃+* Γ((X ⊗ Spec A).left, fst⁻¹ V)`, sending `s ⊗ a` to
285	the product of the pullbacks of `s` (along the first projection) and of `a` (along the

288	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left)) :

301	theorem Over.sectionsBaseChange_tmul_one {V : X.left.Opens}
302	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left))
303	    (s : Γ(X.left, V)) :
304	    Over.sectionsBaseChange X A hV hV' (s ⊗ₜ 1) =
305	      (fst X (overSpec k A)).left.appLE V ((fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl s :=
306	  congr($((CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct k Γ(X.left, V) A).inl_isoIsPushout_hom _ _
307	    (Over.isPushout_algebraMap_sections X A hV hV')).hom s)
308	
309	theorem Over.sectionsBaseChange_one_tmul {V : X.left.Opens}
310	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left)) (a : A) :
311	    Over.sectionsBaseChange X A hV hV' (1 ⊗ₜ a) =
312	      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫
313	        (snd X (overSpec k A)).left.appLE ⊤ ((fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
314	          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd X (overSpec k A)).left).ge)) a :=
315	  congr($((CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct k Γ(X.left, V) A).inr_isoIsPushout_hom _ _
316	    (Over.isPushout_algebraMap_sections X A hV hV')).hom a)

318	/-- The base-change equivalence on a pure tensor: `s ⊗ a` goes to the product of the
319	pullback of `s` along the first projection and the pullback of `a` along the second. -/
320	theorem Over.sectionsBaseChange_tmul {V : X.left.Opens}
321	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left))
322	    (s : Γ(X.left, V)) (a : A) :
323	    Over.sectionsBaseChange X A hV hV' (s ⊗ₜ a) =
324	      (fst X (overSpec k A)).left.appLE V ((fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl s *
325	      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of A)).inv ≫
326	        (snd X (overSpec k A)).left.appLE ⊤ ((fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
327	          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd X (overSpec k A)).left).ge)) a := by
328	  have h : (s ⊗ₜ[k] a : Γ(X.left, V) ⊗[k] A) = (s ⊗ₜ 1) * (1 ⊗ₜ a) := by
329	    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.tmul_mul_tmul, mul_one, one_mul]
330	  rw [h, map_mul, Over.sectionsBaseChange_tmul_one, Over.sectionsBaseChange_one_tmul]

333	/-- **Naturality of the base-change equivalence in the open**: for `W ≤ V` (both qcqs),
334	restricting the base-changed section is base-changing the restriction. The map on tensor
335	products is `Algebra.TensorProduct.map` of the restriction `Over.resAlgHom` and the
336	identity of `A`. -/
337	theorem Over.sectionsBaseChange_naturality {V W : X.left.Opens}
338	    (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left)) (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left))
339	    (hW : IsCompact (W : Set X.left)) (hW' : IsQuasiSeparated (W : Set X.left))
340	    (hWV : W ≤ V) (x : Γ(X.left, V) ⊗[k] A) :
341	    (X ⊗ overSpec k A).left.presheaf.map
342	        (homOfLE (show (fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ W ≤
343	          (fst X (overSpec k A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V by gcongr)).op
344	      (Over.sectionsBaseChange X A hV hV' x) =
345	      Over.sectionsBaseChange X A hW hW'
346	        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (Over.resAlgHom X hWV) (AlgHom.id k A) x) := by
347	  induction x with
348	  | zero => simp only [map_zero]
349	  | add x y hx hy => simp only [map_add, hx, hy]
350	  | tmul s a =>
351	    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_tmul, AlgHom.coe_id, id_eq, Over.resAlgHom_apply,
352	      Over.sectionsBaseChange_tmul, Over.sectionsBaseChange_tmul, map_mul]
353	    congr 1
354	    · rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map, ← CommRingCat.comp_apply,
355	        Scheme.Hom.map_appLE]
356	    · rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, Category.assoc, Scheme.Hom.appLE_map]

8	/-!
9	# Base change of sections along the base-field transition (gap G-D5(b), SB-2)
10	
11	For the challenge curve `C : Over (Spec k)` (`k` a field), field extensions `K₁ K₂` of `k`,
12	a `k`-algebra map `φ : K₁ →ₐ[k] K₂`, and the **base-field transition**
13	
14	`π := (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap φ).left : (C ⊗ overSpec k K₂).left ⟶ (C ⊗ overSpec k K₁).left`,
15	
16	this file identifies the sections of `C_{K₂} := (C ⊗ overSpec k K₂).left` over `π ⁻¹ᵁ V`
17	with the base change of the sections of `C_{K₁} := (C ⊗ overSpec k K₁).left` over `V`:
18	
19	`Γ(C_{K₁}, V) ⊗[K₁] K₂ ≃+* Γ(C_{K₂}, π ⁻¹ᵁ V)`
20	
21	(`AlgebraicGeometry.Over.transitionSectionsBaseChange`), for **affine** `V` — affine `V`
22	suffices for the whole E-iv-alg campaign (`informal/deg-d5b-worksheet.md` §2, §4 SB-2), so
23	this file descopes to the affine case throughout.
24	
25	The `K₁`-algebra structure on `Γ(C_{K₁}, V)` is the one carried by the second-projection
26	`Over`-structure of `Curve.BaseChangeInstances` (`instOverBaseChange`, i.e.
27	`(C ⊗ overSpec k K₁).left ↘ Spec K₁ = (snd C (overSpec k K₁)).left`, worksheet risk 3(a)):
28	concretely `baseChangeSectionsAlgebra C K₁`, which is `Over.sectionsAlgebra` of the bundled
29	curve `Over.mk (snd C (overSpec k K₁)).left` but keyed on the `(C ⊗ overSpec k K₁).left`
30	spelling so typeclass resolution finds it.
31	
32	## Template and engine
33	
34	The template is the landed `Cohomology.SectionsBaseChange`; this file re-runs its (short)
35	proof pattern against the **pasted pullback square** `isPullback_baseFieldTransition` of
36	`Curve.BaseFieldTransition` (worksheet D3) in place of `Over.isPullback_left`. The engine is
37	mathlib's pushout-sections machinery on affine opens, `isIso_pushoutSection_of_isAffineOpen`.
38	As the worksheet warns, we do **not** instantiate the landed `Over.sectionsBaseChange` at base
39	`K₁` and transport along a scheme iso — that would manufacture the shuffle iso D1 avoids.
40	
41	## Main declarations
42	
43	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isPushout_transitionSections_of_isAffineOpen` — the raw pushout
44	  square of section rings (no algebra structure; general `φ`), the direct analogue of
45	  `Over.isPushout_sections_of_isAffineOpen`.
46	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isPushout_algebraMap_transitionSections` — the same square with the
47	  `Γ(Spec K₁, ⊤)`/`Γ(Spec K₂, ⊤)` corners replaced by `K₁`/`K₂`; the top edge is
48	  `algebraMap K₁ Γ(C_{K₁}, V)`, the left edge is `φ` (general `φ`, **no** `Algebra K₁ K₂`
49	  needed). This is the pushout-square form the downstream colength assembly consumes directly
50	  (worksheet SB-2 fallback), combining it with `CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct`.
51	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.transitionSectionsBaseChangeIso`,
52	  `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.transitionSectionsBaseChange` — the comparison isomorphism (in
53	  `CommRingCat`, resp. as a ring equivalence) for a tower `[Algebra K₁ K₂] [IsScalarTower k
54	  K₁ K₂]` with `φ = IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k K₁ K₂`, with the computation rules
55	  `transitionSectionsBaseChange_tmul_one`, `_one_tmul`, `_tmul` and the restriction
56	  naturality `transitionSectionsBaseChange_naturality`.
57	-/

74	/-- **Base change of sections along the transition, raw form.** For an affine open
75	`V ⊆ (C ⊗ overSpec k K₁).left`, the square of section rings
76	
77	```
78	Γ(Spec K₁, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(C_{K₁}, V)
79	     |               |
80	     ↓               ↓
81	Γ(Spec K₂, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(C_{K₂}, π ⁻¹ᵁ V)
82	```

84	(top = second projection of `C_{K₁}`, left = `Spec.map φ`, bottom = the transition `π`,
85	right = second projection of `C_{K₂}`) is a pushout of commutative rings. No flatness is
86	needed in the affine case; the pasted square `isPullback_baseFieldTransition` feeds the
87	engine `isIso_pushoutSection_of_isAffineOpen`. -/
88	theorem Over.isPushout_transitionSections_of_isAffineOpen (φ : K₁ →ₐ[k] K₂)
89	    {V : (C ⊗ overSpec k K₁).left.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
90	    IsPushout
91	      ((snd C (overSpec k K₁)).left.appLE ⊤ V
92	        (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k K₁)).left).ge))
93	      ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom)).appLE ⊤ ⊤
94	        (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom))).ge)
95	      ((C ◁ Over.overSpecMap φ).left.appLE V ((C ◁ Over.overSpecMap φ).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl)
96	      ((snd C (overSpec k K₂)).left.appLE ⊤ ((C ◁ Over.overSpecMap φ).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
97	        (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k K₂)).left).ge)) := by
98	  have hUST : (⊤ : (overSpec k K₂).left.Opens) ≤
99	      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ.toRingHom) ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (overSpec k K₁).left.Opens) :=
100	    (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top _).ge
101	  have hUSX : V ≤ (snd C (overSpec k K₁)).left ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (overSpec k K₁).left.Opens) :=
102	    le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top _).ge
103	  have hUY : (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap φ).left ⁻¹ᵁ V =
104	      (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap φ).left ⁻¹ᵁ V ⊓
105	        (snd C (overSpec k K₂)).left ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (overSpec k K₂).left.Opens) := by
106	    rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top, inf_top_eq]
107	  have h := isIso_pushoutSection_of_isAffineOpen (isPullback_baseFieldTransition C φ)
108	    hUST hUSX hUY (isAffineOpen_top_overSpec k K₁) (isAffineOpen_top_overSpec k K₂) hV
109	  exact (isIso_pushoutSection_iff _ _ _ _).mp h

open CategoryTheory

/-- `Spec` of a `k`-algebra map, as a morphism of `Over (Spec k)`. -/
noncomputable def Over.overSpecMap (f : A →ₐ[k] B) : overSpec k B ⟶ overSpec k A :=
  Over.homMk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom)) (by
    dsimp
    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, AlgHom.comp_algebraMap])

@[simp]
lemma Over.overSpecMap_left (f : A →ₐ[k] B) :
    (Over.overSpecMap f).left = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom f.toRingHom) :=
  rfl

private lemma spec_map_id_alg :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (AlgHom.id k A).toRingHom) = 𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) := by
  rw [show CommRingCat.ofHom (AlgHom.id k A).toRingHom = 𝟙 (CommRingCat.of A) from rfl,
    Spec.map_id]

private lemma spec_map_comp_alg (f : A →ₐ[k] B) (g : B →ₐ[k] C') :
    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (g.comp f).toRingHom)

open CategoryTheory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

/-! ## The `K`-algebra of sections of a scheme over `K` -/

section SectionsAlgebra

variable (K : Type u) [CommRing K] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]

/-- The `K`-algebra structure on `Γ(X, V)` for a scheme over `Spec K`: restriction of
scalars along the landed structure map `Scheme.overAlgebraMap`.  Deliberately **not** a
global instance (it would overlap with mathlib's `Algebra R Γ(Spec R, U)` instances through
the tautological `OverClass X X`; cf. the house rule for `Scheme.overModule`).  Activate
with `attribute [local instance] Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra`; the `finrank` statements of
this file mention it, so consumers must activate the same instance. -/
@[reducible] noncomputable def Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra (V : X.Opens) :
    Algebra K Γ(X, V) :=
  (X.overAlgebraMap K V).toAlgebra

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra

/-- Unfolding lemma: the algebra structure map of `Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra` is the landed
`Scheme.overAlgebraMap`. -/
lemma Scheme.algebraMap_overSectionsAlgebra (V : X.Opens) :
    algebraMap K Γ(X, V) = X.overAlgebraMap K V :=
  rfl

/-- The structure map `K →+* Γ(X, V)` is of finite type on an affine chart of a scheme
locally of finite type over `K`. -/
theorem Scheme.overAlgebraMap_finiteType
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] {V : X.Opens}
    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) : (X.overAlgebraMap K V).FiniteType := by
  have happ : X.overAlgebraMap K V
      = ((X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).appLE ⊤ V le_top).hom.comp
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).inv.hom := by
    rw [Scheme.overAlgebraMap, CommRingCat.hom_comp]
    rfl
  rw [happ]
  exact RingHom.FiniteType.comp
    ((X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)).finiteType_appLE (isAffineOpen_top _) hV le_top)
    (RingHom.FiniteType.of_surjective _
      (((ConcreteCategory.isIso_iff_bijective
        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).inv).mp inferInstance).surjective))

end SectionsAlgebra

/-! ## PROBE 3: the WIDENED section-level keystone on an arbitrary affine open -/

section Probe3

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
variable (R' : Type u) [CommRing R'] [Algebra k R'] [Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R']

/-- PROBE: the raw pushout square of section rings for an ARBITRARY affine open `V` of
`relCurve C R` (no chart, no basic open, no partition of unity). -/
theorem probe_isPushout_relSections {V : (relCurve C R).Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
    IsPushout
      ((snd C (overSpec k R)).left.appLE ⊤ V
        (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k R)).left).ge))
      ((Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R'))).appLE ⊤ ⊤
        (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R')))).ge)
      ((relCurveMap C R R').appLE V (relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl)
      ((snd C (overSpec k R')).left.appLE ⊤ (relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V)
        (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k R')).left).ge)) := by
  have hUST : (⊤ : (overSpec k R').left.Opens) ≤
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R')) ⁻¹ᵁ
        (⊤ : (overSpec k R).left.Opens) :=
    (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top _).ge
  have hUSX : V ≤ (snd C (overSpec k R)).left ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (overSpec k R).left.Opens) :=
    le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top _).ge
  have hUY : relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V =
      relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V ⊓
        (snd C (overSpec k R')).left ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (overSpec k R').left.Opens) := by
    rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top, inf_top_eq]
  have h := isIso_pushoutSection_of_isAffineOpen (probe_isPullback_relCurveMap C R R')
    hUST hUSX hUY (isAffineOpen_top_overSpec k R) (isAffineOpen_top_overSpec k R') hV
  exact (isIso_pushoutSection_iff _ _ _ _).mp h

/-- PROBE: the algebra-corner form. -/
theorem probe_isPushout_algebraMap_relSections {V : (relCurve C R).Opens}
    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
    IsPushout
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R Γ(relCurve C R, V)))
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R'))
      ((relCurveMap C R R').appLE V (relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl)
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R')).inv ≫
        (snd C (overSpec k R')).left.appLE ⊤ (relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V)
          (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd C (overSpec k R')).left).ge)) := by
  refine (probe_isPushout_relSections C R R' hV).of_iso
    (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R)) (Iso.refl _) (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of R')) (Iso.refl _)
    ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
    show _ = _
    rw [show CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R Γ(relCurve C R, V))
        = CommRingCat.ofHom ((relCurve C R).overAlgebraMap R V) from rfl,
      Scheme.overAlgebraMap]
    exact (Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc _ _).symm
  · have h : (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R'))).appLE ⊤ ⊤
        (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R')))).ge =
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R'))).appTop :=
      Scheme.Hom.appLE_eq_app _
    rw [h]
    exact Scheme.ΓSpecIso_naturality (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R'))
  · simp only [Iso.refl_hom, Category.id_comp, Category.comp_id]
  · rw [Iso.refl_hom, Category.comp_id]
    exact (Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc _ _).symm

/-- PROBE: the widened section-level keystone as a ring equivalence. -/
noncomputable def probe_relSectionsBaseChangeAff {V : (relCurve C R).Opens}
    (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
    Γ(relCurve C R, V) ⊗[R] R' ≃+* Γ(relCurve C R', relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ V) :=
  ((CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct R Γ(relCurve C R, V) R').isoIsPushout _ _
    (probe_isPushout_algebraMap_relSections C R R' hV)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv

end Probe3

end AlgebraicGeometry

76	/-! ## Certified families over a widened cover -/
77	
78	/-- **A certified divisor family of degree `n` over a widened cover**: a local-equation
79	system, an affine-open cover datum, an adaptation, and the certificate.  The cover is part of
80	the data (it is chosen per family), exactly as the old `adaptation` field bundled its own
81	`FinCoverData`. -/
82	structure CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff (n : ℕ) : Type u where
83	  /-- The local-equation system on the relative curve. -/
84	  eqns : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations
85	  /-- The affine-open cover carrying the certificate. -/
86	  cover : AffCoverData C R
87	  /-- The adaptation of the system to that cover. -/
88	  adaptation : AffAdaptation cover eqns
89	  /-- The colength certificate of degree `n`. -/
90	  certified : adaptation.IsCertified n
91	
92	/-! ## The widened locally-certified predicate -/
93	
94	variable {C R}
95	
96	/-- **The widened locally-certified pin.**  Identical in shape to `IsLocallyCertified`
97	(`DivisorFamilyZar.lean`) — a span-`⊤` family `g : Fin m → R` with certified families over
98	the away localizations, divisor-equal to the pulled system — except that the local
99	certificates live over ARBITRARY AFFINE-OPEN covers.
100	
101	The base-side structure is untouched on purpose: R2 widens where the pieces live on the
102	CURVE, and changes nothing about the Zariski cover of the base. -/
103	def IsLocallyCertifiedAff (n : ℕ) (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) : Prop :=
104	  ∃ (m : ℕ) (g : Fin m → R), Ideal.span (Set.range g) = ⊤ ∧
105	    ∀ i : Fin m,
106	      haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) :=
107	        isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (g i)) (g i)
108	      ∃ G : CertifiedDivisorFamilyAff C (Localization.Away (g i)) n,
109	        Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq G.eqns
110	          (d.pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i)))
111	            (Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_isOpenImmersion
112	              (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) d))
113	
114	/-- **The widened pin respects divisor equality** — the local `DivEq`s transport through
115	`divEq_pullback`, verbatim as in the chart-typed case. -/
116	theorem IsLocallyCertifiedAff.of_divEq {n : ℕ} {d d' : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
117	    (hd : IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d) (h : Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d d') :
118	    IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d' := by
119	  obtain ⟨m, g, hg, hG⟩ := hd
120	  refine ⟨m, g, hg, fun i => ?_⟩
121	  haveI : IsOpenImmersion (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i))) :=
122	    isOpenImmersion_relCurveMap_away C R (Localization.Away (g i)) (g i)
123	  obtain ⟨G, hGdiv⟩ := hG i
124	  exact ⟨G, hGdiv.trans
125	    (Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_pullback (relCurveMap C R (Localization.Away (g i)))
126	      h _ _)⟩
127	
128	/-! ## The comparison with the chart-typed predicate
129	
130	`FinCoverData.toAffCoverData` (`DivisorFamilyAffCover.lean`) already migrates the COVER
131	sorry-free, and the adaptation's equations and `eqn_rel` transport with it because the pieces
132	are literally the same opens, only reindexed along `finSumFinEquiv`.
133	
134	The migration of the CERTIFICATE is landed too, in `DivisorFamilyAffCompare.lean`
135	(`DivisorAdaptation.isCertified_toAff`, all seven clauses).  Clauses (c1) are `rfl` at the
136	relabelled index; the glued clauses (c2)/(c3)/(c4) transport along `LinearEquiv.piCongrLeft`
137	in its `symm` direction, which evaluates cast-free, so the intertwining with
138	`deltaLeft`/`deltaRight` is componentwise and `Module.rankAtStalk` invariance is
139	`rankAtStalk_eq_of_equiv`.  No clause changes, only the index does.
140	
141	A predecessor docstring here estimated that transport at about a hundred lines of equalizer
142	bookkeeping.  That was wrong by an order of magnitude and the reason generalises: arrange the
143	reindexed cover so its pieces are DEFINITIONALLY the original pieces at the relabelled index,
144	and the overlap data at `(i, j)` becomes `rfl`-equal to the original at `(e i, e j)`, because
145	reindexing acts diagonally on the pair index.  Then no intertwining lemma exists to prove. -/
146	
147	/-! ## The widened functor value -/
148	
149	variable (C R) (n : ℕ)
150	
151	/-- The divisor-equality setoid on widened locally-certified systems. -/
152	def divFamZarAffSetoid : Setoid {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations //
153	    IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d} where
154	  r d₁ d₂ := Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d₁.1 d₂.1
155	  iseqv :=
156	    ⟨fun d => Scheme.LocalEquations.divEq_refl d.1,
157	     fun h => h.symm, fun h h' => h.trans h'⟩
158	
159	/-- **The widened divisor-functor value on the affine test `R`** (R2, I-0492): locally
160	certified systems of degree `n` up to divisor equality, where "certified" is now witnessed by
161	arbitrary affine-open covers of the relative curve.
162	
163	This is the carrier that is field-uniform: no hypothesis on `|P¹(k)|` appears anywhere in its
164	definition or in the per-piece layer that produces it. -/
165	def DivFamZarAff : Type u := Quotient (divFamZarAffSetoid C R n)
166	
167	namespace DivFamZarAff
168	
169	variable {C R n}
170	
171	/-- The class of a widened locally certified system. -/
172	def mk (d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations) (hd : IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d) :
173	    DivFamZarAff C R n :=
174	  Quotient.mk (divFamZarAffSetoid C R n) ⟨d, hd⟩
175	
176	lemma mk_eq_mk_iff {d₁ d₂ : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations}
177	    {h₁ : IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d₁} {h₂ : IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d₂} :
178	    mk d₁ h₁ = mk d₂ h₂ ↔ Scheme.LocalEquations.DivEq d₁ d₂ :=
179	  Quotient.eq (r := divFamZarAffSetoid C R n)
180	
181	/-- **The Picard class of a widened divisor class** `𝒪(D)`, well defined by
182	`picClass_eq_of_divEq`.  This is the Abel hook DAT-C consumes, unchanged by the widening. -/
183	noncomputable def picClass (F : DivFamZarAff C R n) : (relCurve C R).CechPic :=
184	  Quotient.lift
185	    (fun d : {d : (relCurve C R).LocalEquations // IsLocallyCertifiedAff n d} =>
186	      d.1.picClass)
187	    (fun _ _ h => Scheme.LocalEquations.picClass_eq_of_divEq h) F

52	/-- **Purity of the kernel from a flat image**: if `M ⧸ ker δ` is `R`-flat, then the
53	inclusion of `ker δ` stays injective after tensoring with any module. -/
54	theorem lTensor_ker_subtype_injective_of_flat_coker
55	    [Module.Flat R (M ⧸ LinearMap.ker δ)]
56	    (A : Type u) [AddCommGroup A] [Module R A] :
57	    Function.Injective ((LinearMap.ker δ).subtype.lTensor A) :=
58	  lTensor_injective_of_exact_of_flat (LinearMap.ker δ).mkQ
59	    (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _) (LinearMap.ker δ).subtype
60	    (Submodule.injective_subtype _) (exact_subtype_mkQ _) A
61	
62	/-- The map `M ⧸ ker δ → N` induced by `δ`. -/
63	private noncomputable def barMap : M ⧸ LinearMap.ker δ →ₗ[R] N :=
64	  (LinearMap.ker δ).liftQ δ le_rfl
65	
66	private lemma barMap_injective : Function.Injective (barMap δ) := by
67	  rw [← LinearMap.ker_eq_bot, barMap, Submodule.ker_liftQ]
68	  simp
69	
70	private lemma barMap_comp_mkQ : (barMap δ).comp (LinearMap.ker δ).mkQ = δ :=
71	  Submodule.liftQ_mkQ _ _ _
72	
73	/-- **Purity of the image from a flat cokernel**: if `N ⧸ range δ` is `R`-flat, then
74	the induced injection `M ⧸ ker δ → N` stays injective after tensoring with any
75	module. -/
76	private theorem lTensor_barMap_injective_of_flat_coker
77	    [Module.Flat R (N ⧸ LinearMap.range δ)]
78	    (A : Type u) [AddCommGroup A] [Module R A] :
79	    Function.Injective ((barMap δ).lTensor A) := by
80	  refine lTensor_injective_of_exact_of_flat (LinearMap.range δ).mkQ
81	    (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _) (barMap δ) (barMap_injective δ) ?_ A
82	  rw [LinearMap.exact_iff, Submodule.ker_mkQ, barMap, Submodule.range_liftQ]
83	
84	/-- **Kernel base change from flat cokernels** (the `lm:ctn`-lite keystone, plain
85	`lTensor` form): if both `M ⧸ ker δ` and `N ⧸ range δ` are `R`-flat, then for any
86	module `A`, `ker (δ ⊗ A) = range ((ker δ).subtype ⊗ A)`. -/
87	theorem ker_lTensor_eq_of_flat_coker
88	    [Module.Flat R (M ⧸ LinearMap.ker δ)] [Module.Flat R (N ⧸ LinearMap.range δ)]
89	    (A : Type u) [AddCommGroup A] [Module R A] :
90	    LinearMap.ker (δ.lTensor A)
91	      = LinearMap.range ((LinearMap.ker δ).subtype.lTensor A) := by
92	  have hcomp : δ.lTensor A
93	      = ((barMap δ).lTensor A).comp ((LinearMap.ker δ).mkQ.lTensor A) := by
94	    rw [← LinearMap.lTensor_comp, barMap_comp_mkQ]
95	  have hex : Function.Exact ((LinearMap.ker δ).subtype.lTensor A)
96	      ((LinearMap.ker δ).mkQ.lTensor A) :=
97	    lTensor_exact A (exact_subtype_mkQ _) (Submodule.mkQ_surjective _)
98	  rw [hcomp, LinearMap.ker_comp,
99	    LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr (lTensor_barMap_injective_of_flat_coker δ A),
100	    Submodule.comap_bot, LinearMap.exact_iff.mp hex]

104	theorem exact_lTensor_of_flat_coker
105	    [Module.Flat R (M ⧸ LinearMap.ker δ)] [Module.Flat R (N ⧸ LinearMap.range δ)]
106	    (A : Type u) [AddCommGroup A] [Module R A] :
107	    Function.Exact ((LinearMap.ker δ).subtype.lTensor A) (δ.lTensor A) := by

117	theorem tensorKer_bijective_of_flat_coker
118	    [Module.Flat R (M ⧸ LinearMap.ker δ)] [Module.Flat R (N ⧸ LinearMap.range δ)] :
119	    Function.Bijective (LinearMap.tensorKer R' R' δ) := by
120	  constructor

123	    rw [LinearMap.tensorKer_coe, LinearMap.tensorKer_coe] at hcoe
124	    exact lTensor_ker_subtype_injective_of_flat_coker δ R' hcoe
125	  · rintro ⟨z, hz⟩

128	      exact hz
129	    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hz'
130	    exact ⟨w, Subtype.ext (by rw [LinearMap.tensorKer_coe, hw])⟩
131	
132	/-- `tensorKer_bijective_of_flat_coker`, packaged as a linear equivalence
133	`R' ⊗[R] ker δ ≃ₗ[R'] ker (𝟙 ⊗ δ)`. -/

135	    [Module.Flat R (M ⧸ LinearMap.ker δ)] [Module.Flat R (N ⧸ LinearMap.range δ)] :
136	    R' ⊗[R] (LinearMap.ker δ) ≃ₗ[R']
137	      LinearMap.ker (AlgebraTensorModule.lTensor R' R' δ) :=
138	  LinearEquiv.ofBijective (LinearMap.tensorKer R' R' δ)
139	    (tensorKer_bijective_of_flat_coker δ R')
